src/services/watchedService.ts.description: Watch history tracking now supports profile-scoped storage via optional profile_id parameter. When profile_id is provided, storage keys use format @user:${scope}:profile:${profile_id}:@watch_progress:... to isolate watch history per profile.

src/contexts/ProfileContext.tsx.description: Created ProfileContext that provides activeProfile state, loadProfiles, setActiveProfile, and getActiveProfileId. Uses same 'user_profiles' MMKV key as ProfilesScreen. Polls for profile updates every 2 seconds to sync with ProfilesScreen changes.

src/components/home/ContinueWatchingSect.description: ContinueWatchingSection now filters watch progress by active profile using useProfileContext. It supports both profile-scoped keys (profile:${profileId}:type:id:...) and legacy keys for backward compatibility. The component automatically refreshes when activeProfile.id changes.

src/hooks/useFeaturedContent.ts.description: useFeaturedContent now uses profile-scoped caching with profileStoreMap (Map keyed by profileId) and profile-specific MMKV storage keys (featured_content_cache_v2:profile:${profileId}). Content automatically reloads when activeProfile changes via prevProfileIdRef tracking.

src/hooks/useHomeCatalogs.ts.description: useHomeCatalogs now imports useActiveProfile from ProfileContext and tracks profile changes via prevProfileIdRef. Catalogs automatically refresh when profile changes.

src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx.description: HomeScreen now uses useActiveProfile to detect profile changes and triggers catalog refresh when profile switches. It follows the same pattern as useFeaturedContent and useHomeCatalogs hooks with prevProfileIdRef tracking.

src/components/profile/ProfileSwitcherBo.description: ProfileSwitcherBottomSheet is an animated bottom sheet component for switching between profiles. Uses reanimated for animations, gesture-handler for swipe-to-dismiss. Supports PIN-protected profiles with a modal PIN entry. PIN hashes are stored in MMKV with key 'profile_pin_hash_{profileId}'. Component uses ProfileContext for profile data and ThemeContext for theming.

src/navigation/AppNavigator.tsx.description: Profile switcher button added to navigation header. Uses ProfileIcon component and ProfileSwitcherBottomSheet. Button is positioned: (1) In tablet floating nav bar for tablets, (2) Absolute positioned top-right for iOS, (3) Absolute positioned top-right for Android phones. ProfileProvider is wrapped around InnerNavigator in AppNavigator export.
